item.title: [New] Teams meeting policy gains "Who can record and transcribe": admins can stop presenters from recording and lock the choice, from mid-December 2026
item.description:
Recordings and transcripts are data that leaves the meeting; restricting who can start them is a data-loss control, and the precedence order (label, then locked policy, then template) decides what is actually enforced.

Teams · Decide whether sensitive user groups need the locked "organizers and co-organizers" option, and check label and template precedence before assigning the policy.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Teams replaces the Copilot meeting policy with MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI; scripts using the old policy stop working, GA now January 2027
item.description:
"Copilot enforced off" is a governance control; scripts and baselines that set the Copilot policy will fail silently or return guidance once the new policies are on, leaving AI availability different from what the baseline says.

Teams · Find every script, DSC or baseline that sets the Teams Copilot meeting policy and move it to MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI before January 2027; verify the mapped values afterwards.
